_note: Every recipe in the system. Ingredients carry a food key into foods.json for macros, a display string for the card, and an aisle for the basket. basketOnly ingredients are bought but not eaten in this recipe; macroOnly ones are eaten here but bought under another recipe. from pulls whole portions out of another recipe.

chilli.name: Mild Chilli, Double Batch
chilli.notes: Nothing hot goes in the pot. Flakes at the table for the adults.
method: Brown the mince in the biggest pot, breaking it up. Drain any excess fat.
Onion, garlic, pepper and carrot in for 5 minutes until softened.
Spices and tomato puree for 1 minute, stirring.
Everything else in except the chocolate. Simmer 50-60 minutes, lid half off, stirring occasionally.
Chocolate in at the very end, stir until melted. Salt to taste.
chilli.serving_suggestion: With rice pouches and Greek yoghurt.
chilli.adults: Chilli flakes or hot sauce at the table.

basket_notes.dark_chocolate: 15g - one or two squares, not a whole bar

dal.name: Dal
dal.notes: Mild base. The tarka is an adults-only pour-over at the table.
method: Onion, garlic and ginger in oil for 3 minutes.
Turmeric and cumin for 1 minute.
Lentils, chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and stock in. Simmer 30 minutes.
Spinach and garam masala for the last 5 minutes.
Lemon juice at the end. Salt to taste.
dal.serving_suggestion: With rice pouches and a spoon of yoghurt.
dal.adults: Tarka: 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp mustard seeds, 1 tsp cumin seeds, pinch of chilli flakes. Fry 30 seconds and pour over the adults' bowls only.

basket_notes.red_lentils_dry: 500g for the dal, 150g more if you are making minestrone

north_african_chickpea_stew.name: North African Chickpea & Sweet Potato Stew
north_african_chickpea_stew.notes: No harissa in the pot - it goes into the adults' bowls at the table.
method: Onion and garlic in oil for 5 minutes.
Spices for 1 minute.
Sweet potato, chickpeas, tomatoes and stock in. Simmer 25-30 minutes until the sweet potato is soft.
Spinach for the last 5 minutes.
Honey and lemon at the end. Salt to taste.
north_african_chickpea_stew.adults: A spoon of harissa stirred through the bowl.

ragu.name: Beef Ragu, Double Batch
ragu.notes: The long simmer is the whole recipe. Thick enough that a spoon leaves a trail.

ingredients.display: 200ml red wine (or 2 tbsp balsamic + extra stock)

method: Brown the mince in batches in the biggest pot, set aside.
Soffritto - onion, carrot, celery - in the same pot 8-10 minutes on low. Sweat, don't brown.
Garlic for 1 minute. Wine in, reduce 3-4 minutes.
Mince back in. Tomatoes, passata, puree, stock and oregano in with 2 bay leaves and a parmesan rind if you have one.
Simmer 1.5-2 hours, lid off, stirring occasionally.
Fish out the bay leaves and the rind.
ragu.serving_suggestion: With fresh pasta and parmesan. Pasta cooked on the day, never Saturday.

basket_notes.beef_mince_5: the double ragu - a second kilo goes in the meatballs

minestrone.name: Minestrone
minestrone.notes: Optional extra pot in week 4 if the freezer needs topping up. NO pasta in the pot - it goes in when you reheat.
method: Pancetta fried 3 minutes if using.
Onion, garlic, carrot, celery and courgette for 5 minutes.
Tomato puree for 1 minute.
Everything else in except the spinach, with a bay leaf and a parmesan rind. Simmer 25 minutes.
Spinach for the last 5 minutes. Remove the bay leaf and rind.
DO NOT add pasta to the pot.
minestrone.serving_suggestion: Add 100g soup pasta per 4 portions when reheating and simmer 8 minutes. Garlic bread on the side.

pulled_chicken_bag.name: Pulled Chicken Freezer Bag
pulled_chicken_bag.notes: Everything raw into the bag. Freeze flat. Wednesday night into the fridge, Thursday morning into the slow cooker on low.
method: Everything into a freezer bag, raw. Squeeze the air out, seal, label PULLED CHICKEN + the month.
Freeze flat so it stacks.
Wednesday bedtime: bag out of the freezer into the fridge.
Thursday morning: contents into the slow cooker on low. Shred with two forks before serving.
pulled_chicken_bag.serving_suggestion: In wraps with slaw and yoghurt, or over rice pouches.

korma_bag.name: Chicken & Chickpea Korma Freezer Bag
korma_bag.notes: Yoghurt goes on the side when serving, not in the bag.

ingredients.display: Half a jar of korma paste

method: Everything into a freezer bag, raw. Seal, label KORMA + the month, freeze flat.
Wednesday bedtime: into the fridge.
Thursday morning: into the slow cooker on low.
korma_bag.serving_suggestion: Rice pouches, yoghurt on the side, mango chutney.

chicken_olive_tomato_bag.name: Chicken, Olive & Tomato Freezer Bag
chicken_olive_tomato_bag.notes: Fresh basil torn over when serving.
method: Everything into a freezer bag, raw. Seal, label CHICKEN OLIVE + the month, freeze flat.
Wednesday bedtime: into the fridge.
Thursday morning: into the slow cooker on low. Basil torn over at the table.
chicken_olive_tomato_bag.serving_suggestion: Rice pouches or pasta cooked on the day.

sausage_pepper_bag.name: Italian Sausage & Pepper Freezer Bag
sausage_pepper_bag.notes: Chicken sausages (Heck or similar), each cut into 3 chunks.
method: Everything into a freezer bag, raw. Seal, label SAUSAGE PEPPER + the month, freeze flat.
Wednesday bedtime: into the fridge.
Thursday morning: into the slow cooker on low.
sausage_pepper_bag.serving_suggestion: Pasta cooked on the day, or crusty bread.

paprika_chicken_traybake.name: Paprika Chicken Traybake
paprika_chicken_traybake.notes: Tonight's dinner, cooked during the prep session.
method: Oven 200C.
Sweet potato, peppers, onion and garlic in first with the oil, paprika and salt. 15 minutes head start.
Chicken on top, skin up. 35-40 minutes more.
Lemon squeezed over at the table.
paprika_chicken_traybake.adults: 2 tbsp yoghurt with 1 tsp harissa each, on the side.

salmon_traybake_glazed.name: Glazed Salmon Traybake
salmon_traybake_glazed.notes: Tonight's dinner, cooked during the prep session.
method: Oven 200C. Mix the glaze: soy, honey and the juice of half the lemon.
Potatoes in with oil and salt, 20 minutes on their own.
Broccoli and tomatoes in, glazed salmon on top. 15 minutes more.
Dill or parsley scattered over. The other lemon half squeezed at the table.

harissa_chicken_squash_traybake.name: Harissa Chicken with Squash & Chickpeas
harissa_chicken_squash_traybake.notes: Mild harissa only in the tray. The hot stuff comes out at the table.
method: Oven 200C.
Squash, chickpeas and onion in with the oil, harissa and salt. 15 minutes head start.
Chicken on top. 35-40 minutes more.
Honey drizzled over at the end.

meatball_al_forno.name: Meatball & Ricotta Al Forno, Doubled
meatball_al_forno.notes: Doubled - one tray is tonight's dinner, the second is portioned for lunch boxes and the freezer. Don't over-mix the meatballs.
method: Mince, half the ricotta, breadcrumbs, half the parmesan, eggs, lemon zest and most of the basil together. Form meatballs - don't over-mix.
Brown the meatballs in batches, set aside.
Sauce: courgette, peppers and onion 5 minutes. Garlic 1 minute. Sun-dried tomato paste and puree 1 minute.
Butter beans, paprika, passata, stock and balsamic in. Simmer 10 minutes.
Meatballs into the sauce across two trays. Remaining parmesan and ricotta dotted on top.
220C (fan 200C) for 15-20 minutes.
One tray is dinner. The second cools, then splits: meatballs for the lunch boxes, the rest bagged for the freezer.
meatball_al_forno.serving_suggestion: Bread and a green salad. No pasta needed.

roast_two_chickens.name: Two Roast Chickens
roast_two_chickens.notes: Two birds, because Monday and the lunch boxes both live off the leftovers. Strip both carcasses the same evening.
method: Oven 190C. Both birds in together, roughly 20 minutes per 500g plus 20.
Potatoes in oil and salt for the last hour, turned once.
Carrots and broccoli in the last 20 minutes.
Rest 15 minutes while the gravy comes together.
After dinner, strip both carcasses. ~350g goes in a tub for Monday, ~400g in a tub for the lunch box protein. Carcasses into the freezer for stock, or the bin.

slow_roast_pork.name: Slow Roast Pork Shoulder
slow_roast_pork.notes: Low and slow, in early. Wednesday's fried rice comes out of the leftovers.
method: Skin scored, salted hard, left uncovered in the fridge overnight if you remember.
Oven 220C for 30 minutes to start the crackling, then down to 150C for 4-5 hours.
Potatoes and veg in for the last hour, oven back up to 200C for the final 20 minutes.
Rest 20 minutes. Pull or slice.
Set aside ~300g diced for Wednesday's fried rice before it all disappears.

gammon_roast.name: Gammon Joint
gammon_roast.notes: Wednesday's gammon and eggs comes out of this. Save ~400g.
method: Gammon simmered in water 1.5-2 hours, or slow cooker on low all afternoon.
Skin off, fat scored, honey and mustard glaze on. 200C for 20 minutes to colour.
Potatoes and veg roasted alongside.
Rest 15 minutes. Slice ~400g into a tub for Wednesday before serving.

roast_beef_topside.name: Roast Beef Topside
roast_beef_topside.notes: Wednesday's orzo wants ~300g shredded. Cut it before it goes.
method: Oven 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C - 15 minutes per 500g for pink, 20 for done.
Potatoes in oil and salt for the last hour.
Rest 20 minutes under foil - this matters more than the timing.
Yorkshires and veg while it rests.
Set aside ~300g for Wednesday's orzo.

chicken_fajita_bowls.name: Chicken Fajita Bowls
chicken_fajita_bowls.notes: Together night. Everything on the table, build your own.
method: Peppers fried hard with the fajita spice, 5 minutes.
Rice pouches in the microwave.
Chicken warmed through, or straight from the fridge cold - either works.
Everything in bowls in the middle of the table.

chilli_with_rice.name: Chilli with Rice
chilli_with_rice.notes: Tuesday's tub of chilli from Saturday.
method: Chilli into a pan on a low heat, 10 minutes, or the microwave in bowls.
Rice pouches at the last minute.
Yoghurt on top.

chilli_loaded_sweet_potatoes.name: Chilli-Loaded Sweet Potatoes
chilli_loaded_sweet_potatoes.notes: Potatoes go on a timer before anyone is home.
method: Sweet potatoes pricked, oven timer 200C for 45 minutes.
Chilli reheated while they finish.
Split, loaded, cheese and yoghurt on top.

tandoori_chicken_bowls.name: Tandoori Chicken Bowls
tandoori_chicken_bowls.notes: Thighs roasted Saturday alongside the lunch box batch. Warm or cold, both fine.
method: Rice pouches in the microwave.
Thighs sliced, warmed 2 minutes or served cold.
Mint yoghurt from the fridge, chutney, cucumber and leaves on the table. Build your own.

dal_with_rice.name: Dal with Rice
dal_with_rice.notes: Tuesday's tub of dal from Saturday.
method: Dal into a pan on low, 10 minutes. It thickens - loosen with a splash of water.
Rice pouches at the last minute.
dal_with_rice.adults: The tarka, made fresh: 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp mustard seeds, 1 tsp cumin seeds, pinch of chilli flakes, 30 seconds in the pan, poured over.

pork_fried_rice.name: Pork Fried Rice
pork_fried_rice.notes: Make the lot at the first sitting, microwave per person after.
method: Pork crisped in a hot pan, 3 minutes.
Frozen veg and garlic in, 4 minutes.
Rice pouches broken in, soy over, tossed 3 minutes.
Eggs scrambled into a gap in the pan, then stirred through.
Sesame oil off the heat. Spring onions on top.

chicken_wraps.name: Chicken Wraps
chicken_wraps.notes: Together night. Same idea as the other Mondays, but wrapped instead of over rice.
method: Wraps warmed 20 seconds in the microwave under a damp cloth, or 2 minutes in a dry pan.
Everything on the table. Lemon dressing from the jar.
Build your own.

chickpea_stew_with_couscous.name: Chickpea Stew with Couscous
chickpea_stew_with_couscous.notes: Tuesday's tub of stew from Saturday. Couscous made on the day - 5 minutes in a bowl.
method: Stew into a pan on low, 10 minutes.
Couscous in a bowl, boiling water just over the top, plate on, 5 minutes. Fork through.
Coriander over.

gammon_eggs_chips.name: Gammon, Eggs & Sweet Potato Chips
gammon_eggs_chips.notes: Chips part-cooked on Saturday, finished on the night.
method: Chips out of the fridge, oven timer 200C for 20 minutes.
Gammon slices warmed in a dry pan, 2 minutes a side.
Eggs fried on the day, one each and one spare.

lasagne.name: Lasagne
lasagne.notes: Assembled cold on Saturday from the ragu, sits raw in the fridge until Monday. Oven timer job.
method: Saturday: ragu, sheets, white sauce, repeat. Spinach layer if you want it. Cheese on top. Cover, fridge.
Monday: oven timer 190C, 40 minutes from the fridge.
Stand 10 minutes before cutting or it slides.

ragu_with_pasta.name: Ragu with Pasta
ragu_with_pasta.notes: Tuesday's tub of ragu from Saturday. Pasta on the day, always.
method: Ragu into a pan on low while the water comes up.
Fresh pasta 3 minutes.
Pasta into the sauce, not the other way round. Splash of pasta water. Parmesan over.

beef_tomato_orzo.name: Beef & Tomato Orzo
beef_tomato_orzo.notes: One pan. The beef goes in at the very end - it toughens if it cooks.

ingredients.display: 1 courgette, diced (or a handful of frozen peas)

method: Orzo, stock and tomatoes into a pan. Simmer 10-12 minutes, stirring so it doesn't catch.
Courgette in for the last 3 minutes.
Beef in for the last 2 minutes only, just to warm.
Lemon zest and parmesan over.

margherita_pizza.name: Margherita, the Boys'
margherita_pizza.notes: Dough out of the freezer into the fridge on Thursday night.
method: Oven as hot as it goes with the tray or stone in it.
Dough stretched by hand, not rolled. Passata thin, cheese torn on.
8-12 minutes depending on the oven.

chorizo_pepper_pizza.name: Chorizo & Pepper, the Adults'
chorizo_pepper_pizza.notes: Topping under the cheese. Less mozzarella than the boys'.
method: Chorizo and pepper on the passata, cheese over the top. Same oven, same time as the boys'.

tandoori_chicken_pizza.name: Tandoori Chicken, the Adults'
tandoori_chicken_pizza.notes: Chutney dotted on after it comes out, not before.
method: Chicken tossed in spice and oil, on the passata, cheese over. Chutney dotted on once it's out.

halloumi_pepper_pizza.name: Halloumi & Pepper, the Adults'
halloumi_pepper_pizza.notes: Halloumi sliced thin or it stays squeaky.
method: Peppers and onion on the passata, halloumi and mozzarella over the top.

pepperoni_pizza.name: Pepperoni, the Adults'
pepperoni_pizza.notes: The simplest one. Don't overthink it.
method: Pepperoni on the passata, cheese over. Chilli oil after, for the adults.

chopped_salad_w1.name: Chopped Salad
chopped_salad_w1.notes: Goes on the table with the pizzas. The eggs are 4 of Saturday's 8.
method: Everything chopped small, dressed at the last minute so the chips stay crunchy.

cucumber_tomato_salad_w2.name: Cucumber & Tomato Salad
cucumber_tomato_salad_w2.notes: Cooling, to sit next to the tandoori pizza.
method: Cucumber in half-moons, tomatoes in wedges. Mint yoghurt loosened with lemon, spooned over.

greek_salad_w3.name: Greek Salad
greek_salad_w3.notes: No leaves in a proper one. Big chunks.
method: Chunks, not slices. Feta in a slab on top. Oil, lemon and oregano over.

tomato_mozzarella_salad_w4.name: Tomato & Mozzarella Salad
tomato_mozzarella_salad_w4.notes: Beans make it a salad you can actually eat a bowl of.
method: Beans dressed first so they take the flavour, then everything else folded through.

roast_chicken_stripped.name: Roast Paprika Chicken for the Boxes
roast_chicken_stripped.notes: 1kg of thighs roasts down to ~800g - 80g per box across 10 boxes. Goes in the oven with the veg tray.
method: Thighs tossed in oil and paprika, spread on a tray. 200C for 30-35 minutes. Cooled, then sliced or torn.

basket_notes.chicken_thigh_boneless: 1kg for the lunch boxes, 600g more for Thursday's freezer bag

tandoori_thighs.name: Tandoori Thighs for the Boxes
tandoori_thighs.notes: Marinate first thing, roast when the oven frees up. Monday's bowls come off the same tray - cook 1.6kg total.
method: Yoghurt, spice and lemon mixed, thighs turned through it. 200C for 30-35 minutes until the edges char.

roast_chicken_lemon.name: Lemon Chicken for the Boxes
roast_chicken_lemon.notes: Cook 1.4kg - 1kg for the boxes and 350g for Monday's wraps.
method: Oil, lemon and oregano over the thighs. 200C for 30-35 minutes. 1kg cooled for the boxes, 350g in a tub for Monday.

meatballs_from_traybake.name: Meatballs from the Al Forno Tray
meatballs_from_traybake.notes: No extra cooking - two portions off the second tray, split across the ten boxes.
method: Once the second tray has cooled, lift out the meatballs for the boxes. A spoon of the tray sauce goes in with them.

lunchbox_veg_tray_w1.name: Lunch Box Veg Tray
lunchbox_veg_tray_w1.notes: One big tray, 100g per box. Roasts down, so weigh generously.
method: Everything on the biggest tray, oiled and salted. 200C for 30-35 minutes once the flapjacks are out. Cool before it goes near a box.

lunchbox_veg_tray_w2.name: Lunch Box Veg Tray
method: Everything on the biggest tray, oiled and salted. 200C for 25-30 minutes. Cool completely.

lunchbox_veg_tray_w3.name: Lunch Box Veg Tray
method: Everything on the biggest tray, oiled and salted. 200C for 30-35 minutes. Cool completely.

lunchbox_veg_tray_w4.name: Lunch Box Veg Tray
method: Everything on the biggest tray, oiled and salted. 200C for 25-30 minutes. Cool completely.

house_vinaigrette.name: House Vinaigrette
house_vinaigrette.notes: Monthly batch - keeps 3-4 weeks in a jar in the fridge. 2 tbsp per lunch box.
method: Everything in a jam jar. Lid on, shake hard. Shake again before each use.

lemon_dressing.name: Lemon Dressing
lemon_dressing.notes: Monthly batch. 2 tbsp per lunch box.
method: Everything in a jam jar. Lid on, shake hard.

balsamic_vinaigrette.name: Balsamic Vinaigrette
balsamic_vinaigrette.notes: Monthly batch. 2 tbsp per lunch box.
method: Everything in a jam jar. Lid on, shake hard.

mint_yoghurt.name: Mint Yoghurt
mint_yoghurt.notes: The one dressing that will not keep a month - make it fresh in week 2.
method: Mint chopped fine, stirred through the yoghurt with the lemon and a good pinch of salt.

lunchbox_w1.name: Lunch Box, Week 1
lunchbox_w1.notes: Ten of these - five each. Built bottom-to-top so the leaves stay out of the dressing.
method: Dressing in the bottom.
Rice, then beans, then chicken, then roast veg.
Pickled onions, then leaves on top.
Finisher goes on the day, not now - especially the crunchy ones and the boiled eggs.

lunchbox_w2.name: Lunch Box, Week 2
method: Mint yoghurt in the bottom.
Rice, then beans, then tandoori chicken, then roast veg.
Pickled onions, then leaves on top.
Finisher on the day.

lunchbox_w3.name: Lunch Box, Week 3
method: Lemon dressing in the bottom.
Rice, then beans, then lemon chicken, then roast veg.
Pickled onions, then leaves on top.
Finisher on the day.

lunchbox_w4.name: Lunch Box, Week 4
lunchbox_w4.notes: Ten of these - five each. The protein comes off the second al forno tray.
method: Balsamic vinaigrette in the bottom.
Rice, then beans, then meatballs, then roast veg.
Pickled onions, then leaves on top.
Finisher on the day.

sandwiches_adults.name: Saturday Sandwich, Adults'
sandwiches_adults.notes: Cold lunch on prep day. Double filling - the evening is a long one.
method: Made and eaten standing up, probably.

sandwiches_boys.name: Saturday Sandwich, Boys'
method: Crusts on. They'll live.

tuna_pasta_salad.name: Tuna Pasta Salad
tuna_pasta_salad.notes: The one exception to the pasta rule - made Saturday for Sunday lunch, because it is meant to be cold. Yoghurt and seeds go on Sunday, not now.
method: Pasta cooked, peas thrown in for the last 2 minutes, both drained and run under cold water.
Tuna, cucumber, tomatoes and lemon folded through. Eggs quartered on top.
Fridge. Sunday: yoghurt loosened with a splash of water, stirred through, seeds over.

boiled_eggs.name: Boiled Eggs
boiled_eggs.notes: 2 in the tuna pasta salad, 4 in Friday's salad, 1 in Thursday's lunch box, 1 spare.
method: Into boiling water, 8 minutes, straight into cold. Keep them in their shells in the fridge.

quick_pickled_red_onions.name: Quick Pickled Red Onions
quick_pickled_red_onions.notes: Every Saturday, or skip it if last week's jar is still good - they keep 4-6 weeks.
method: Onions into a jar. Vinegar, sugar and a good pinch of salt warmed until dissolved, poured over. Lid on, 30 minutes minimum.

smoothie_bag.name: Smoothie Bag
smoothie_bag.notes: Ten bags. Fill them all one ingredient at a time - spinach in all ten, then berries in all ten, and so on. Back in the freezer standing in a tub.
method: Frozen things into the bag Saturday. Bag flat in the freezer.
In the morning: bag into the blender with the protein powder, creatine and milk.

flapjack_plain_seed.name: Seed Flapjacks
flapjack_plain_seed.notes: First thing in the oven at 180C, before anything else needs it.
method: Butter, peanut butter and honey melted together in a pan.
Off the heat, everything else stirred in.
Pressed hard into a lined tin - hard, or they crumble.
180C for 22-25 minutes. Cool completely in the tin before cutting into 12.

flapjack_cinnamon_raisin.name: Cinnamon & Raisin Flapjacks
flapjack_cinnamon_raisin.notes: First thing in the oven at 180C.
method: Butter, peanut butter and honey melted together in a pan.
Off the heat, everything else stirred in.
Pressed hard into a lined tin.
180C for 22-25 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into 12.

flapjack_lemon_seed.name: Lemon & Seed Flapjacks
flapjack_lemon_seed.notes: First thing in the oven at 180C.

ingredients.display: Zest and juice of a lemon

method: Butter, peanut butter and honey melted together in a pan.
Off the heat, everything else stirred in.
Pressed hard into a lined tin.
180C for 22-25 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into 12.

flapjack_cocoa.name: Cocoa Flapjacks
flapjack_cocoa.notes: First thing in the oven at 180C.
method: Butter, peanut butter and honey melted together in a pan.
Off the heat, everything else stirred in. The cocoa wants sifting or it clumps.
Pressed hard into a lined tin.
180C for 22-25 minutes. Cool completely before cutting into 12.

ee_meatball.name: Meatball & Ricotta Al Forno
ee_meatball.classification: Rotation-ready - in rotation as week 4's traybake

ee_goulash.name: Goulash
ee_goulash.classification: Rotation-ready - week 1 batch pot alternative, winter

ee_chicken_orzo.name: One-Pot Mediterranean Chicken Orzo
ee_chicken_orzo.classification: Rotation-ready with a tweak - orzo goes in on the day, not in the pot

ee_multivitamin.name: Nature's Multivitamin Salad
ee_multivitamin.classification: Side salad only - too low in protein to be a dinner

ee_mango_jalapeno.name: Mango, Jalapeno & Lime Salad
ee_mango_jalapeno.classification: Summer cold/assemble - jalapeno on the side for the boys

ee_stir_fry.name: Sticky Peanut Stir Fry
ee_stir_fry.classification: Component prep / quick-cook - week 3 Wednesday swap

ee_salmon_veg.name: Salmon and Sexy Veg
ee_salmon_veg.classification: Component prep - week 3 Sunday swap in summer

ee_risotto.name: Oven-Baked Risotto with Smoked Salmon & Peas
